text: PKG-3 (no effect deps in pure modules) implemented as in linop4s and VERIFIED NEGATIVELY: injecting cats-effect into kernel fails with the transitive artifacts listed. PKG-1 REDESIGNED. The planned check -- 'kernel must not depend on core' -- is VACUOUS: core already depends on kernel, so a kernel->core edge is a cycle and sbt rejects the build at load before any task runs. The violation it guarded cannot be expressed. The real failure mode is a CONTENT violation: someone declaring Fixation or Saccade inside the kernel, which is what PRD A-3 actually describes. checkKernelPurity is now a source scan of kernel/src against a documented ocular word list, with comments blanked out (preserving newlines, so reported line numbers refer to the real file). Verified negatively: a planted 'final case class Fixation' is flagged at its true line, while 'fixation' and 'saccade' in the adjacent scaladoc are correctly ignored.
